newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Oct 24-Nov 22 inflation at 0.58 pct - Fipe.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Oct 24-Nov 22 inflation at 0.58 pct - Fipe.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.58 percent for the period between October 24 and November 22, down from 0.75 percent in the previous four-week period, a Fipe official said.
Eased pressure on food, particularly of meat and cereals, and clothing prices helped to slow inflation in the period, said Juarez Rizzieri, the president of the Fipe institute.
Rizzieri estimates inflation for the whole month of November will be around 0.5 percent.
The Fipe institute also announced the following breakdown of its weighted inflation index for the period:
- Food 0.40 pct rise in the period
- Housing 0.66 pct rise in the period
- Transportation 0.68 pct rise in the period
- Personal expenses 0.24 pct rise in the period
- Clothing 1.79 pct rise in the period
- Health care 0.20 pct rise in the period
- Education 0.07 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
